name: LinkedIn Clone
description: 7-service platform (gateway, user, connections, posts, uploader, notifications, Eureka) with a database per service. The social graph lives in Neo4j, Kafka decouples notifications across 5 topics, and Kubernetes manifests make it GKE-deployable.

name: JobChain
tag: Hackathon · team of 4 · built in 36 hours
description: Blockchain-secured exam management. Papers, answer keys and scores are anchored on Polygon as SHA-256 hashes, so tampering is publicly detectable. Includes marks-anomaly and answer-leak fraud engines.

name: Hotel Booking Platform
description: Dynamic pricing engine built with the Decorator pattern (base, surge, occupancy, urgency, holiday). Double-booking prevented with pessimistic row locks and a 10-minute soft reservation. Full Stripe flow with 3-tier RBAC.

name: Course Search API
description: 8-parameter filter API with fuzzy search and real-time autocomplete. Fully containerized with Docker Compose and auto-indexes on boot.

name: Anemia Detection
description: Detection plus WHO-based severity classification on 9,468 patient records. Random Forest reached 99.72% recall on the held-out set and 97.12% on an independent dataset. Deployed in an Android app.

name: SkyVidya & Nawani Tours
description: Responsive websites built and deployed for two paying clients. Both are live and maintained.
